1.

2. Heard Sri Alok Kumar Srivastava, Advocate holding brief of Sri Yogesh Kumar, learned counsel for the applicant and Sri Shiv Shankar Kaithal, learned counsel for the informant as well as Sri S.P.
Pandey, learned A.G.A. for the State and also perused the record.

3. The present application for anticipatory bail has been filed for protection in regard to Case No.1990 of 2001 arising out of FIR/Case Crime No. 76 of 1991, under Sections 420 & 468 of I.P.C.,
P.S.- Mangalpur, District- Kanpur Dehat.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
After arguing for some time, applicant's counsel submits that the present application for anticipatory bail may be disposed of with liberty to file a regular bail application which may be decided keeping in view the guidelines as laid down by the Apex Court in the case of Satender Kumar Antil vs. Central Bureau of Investigation and another, reported in 2022 SCC Online SC 825.
5.

entities.text: Satender Kumar Antil vs. Central Bureau of Investigation and another, reported in 2022 SCC Online SC 825
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the informant as well as learned AGA have no objection to the prayer made by the learned counsel for the applicant.

6. After hearing learned counsel for the parties, no case is made out for interference u/s 438 Cr.P.C..
The present anticipatory bail application is disposed of with the direction that the applicant shall surrender before the court concerned within four weeks from today and in case, a regular bail application is filed, the same be decided in view of the law laid down by the Supreme Court in the case of Satender Kumar Antil (supra).

7. For the period of four weeks from today or till the time of surrender of the applicant before the court concerned, whichever is earlier, no coercive action shall be taken against the applicant, in the above case.

(Justice Krishan Pahal) Order Date :- 17.11.2023 Siddhant  Mahadev Prasad vs State Of U.P. And Another on 17 November, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/75180549/
